accessible_text: Geometry, material, chrome and depth can change independently. The labels and reading order are written in the artwork and annotation.

viewport.units: authored SVG canvas, not a breakpoint

input_scale.zoom: inspect at normal and enlarged scale

local_dimensions.canvas: 1200×720 authored fixture only; sizes and timings are not global tokens

annotations: Use only core/TOKENS.json for exact color values.
Current visual-evidence boards show approved material/depth examples; sample highlights are not token values.
Reference SVG embeds the packaged Space Grotesk WOFF2 so authored text does not depend on a viewer-installed font.
